7. As per the complaint averment, the marriage of the petitioner with complainant was solemnized on 15.11.2015 and after the marriage, the couple were residing in Uganda for a period about 6 years.
Thereafter in the year 2022, they had returned to India.

sentences.text:
8. In the complaint it is averred that the complainant had filed 3 separate cases against the NC:
2024:KHC-D:848 petitioner herein including divorce petition and maintenance petition.

On 24.11.2023, when the complainant was returning after attending the Court at about 12.30 p.m., the petitioner and his father came in car bearing registration No.KA.34/S-1215 and forcibly took the complainant in the said car and thereafter, threatened her with dire consequences if she does not withdraw the cases filed by her against him.
It is also averred in the complaint that an attempt was made to commit her murder.

In the complaint, it is stated that the accused No.2 held the hands of the complainant and accused No.1 tried to strangulate her neck, at that time two persons came to the spot and rescued the complainant.
Accused No.2 has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Criminal Petition No.103788/2023.
Petitioner is in custody from 15.12.2023.
Undisputedly, the complainant has not suffered any injury in the incident that has been taken place on 24.11.2023.
In the complaint, it is averred that the complainant is staying separately from the petitioner and she had filed 3 cases against him.
Complaint was NC: 2024:KHC-D:848 lodged on 25.11.2023 at 10.30 a.m., there is a delay of 22 hours in filing the complaint.
In view of the aforesaid aspects, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner in the application for grant of regular bail, is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.215/2023 registered by Women Police Station, Bellari for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323,
504, 341, 307, r/w Section 34 of the IPC, subject to the following conditions:
i.

The petitioner/accused No.1 shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with 2 sureties for the like-sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
ii.

The petitioner/accused No.1 shall appear regularly on all the dates of hearing before NC:
2024:KHC-D:848 the Trial Court unless the Trial Court exempts his appearance for valid reasons;
iii. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall not directly or indirectly threaten or tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
iv. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Trial Court without permission of the said Court until the case registered against him is disposed off.
